status: five selected original proposals; no implementation authorized by this dossier

packets.title: A finite retort with two real outputs and a visible stall
packets.player_behavior: At an opt-in Village work site, choose a small resin-distillation batch. It produces useful sealing resin plus spent residue in separate owned trays. Collect, safely repurpose or dispose of residue before further batches; a full tray pauses future starts.
packets.state_owner: Existing command/job/site/inventory/publication owners; a new narrow site-capacity adapter must be explicit.
packets.costs: One actual input lot, declared fuel or actor effort and one site reservation. Exact fiction/rates remain proposals.
packets.prerequisites: Reconcile current resin/material owners; bind exact item keys and actual site rights. Reuse existing finite work plan; do not create another timer.
packets.mutations: At acceptance reserve this batch only and reserve both output destinations. At supported settlement publish both realized outputs and capacity use once. Collection clears the matching tray only.
packets.downstream_consumer: Sealing resin prepares an existing surveying/storage application; residue has a separate authored safe sink with its own costs.
packets.time_policy: Existing supported played clock. Accepted jobs retain pinned definitions and suspension policy; future starts re-quote actual support.
packets.failure_and_cancellation: Missing fuel/input/site/receiver capacity denies the next batch without spending. Accepted cancellation terms are explicit; output failure cannot silently delete/refund processed material or spill into someone else’s stock.
observable_gate: A normal batch spends its actual input and yields two distinct owned outputs.
Ignoring the residue tray stalls future starts with the cause shown.
Collecting/disposing the exact residue re-enables a supported next batch.
Cancel/save/reload cannot double input returns, output or site capacity.
packets.engine_gap: Current deterministic stock-band projection is single-output. Receiver capacity and coproduct settlement need a qualified original adapter.
packets.save_compatibility: Optional new records absent in older saves mean unenrolled. Schema/validation decision and generated-save later gate are required; no private save reads.
packets.proposed_write_scope: New isolated content/host/definition modules; root owns any registry/native/state/save/UI joins.
packets.verification_state: proposal-only; not implemented; later gameplay/save/failure acceptance deferred

packets.title: Measure one better tool, then prove its useful function
packets.player_behavior: Use a known stamped brace or lens sample to choose a precise finishing method, ordinary serviceable use, or lossy salvage. A successful finish improves one measurable load/measurement function used in a later task; quality is not just a sale-price badge.
packets.state_owner: Existing native full item keys and unique maker history; current sample/material/fit owner must be reused.
packets.costs: Actual selected object, finishing materials, willing craftsperson time/site and optional premium method.
packets.prerequisites: Pin current measured material and equipment functions; preserve continuous native quality and ordinary option.
packets.mutations: Consume/replace the selected owned key once; retain provenance and declared property. Salvage yields explicitly fewer useful inputs plus waste, without returning already consumed fluid/fuel.
packets.downstream_consumer: A later load-bearing job or measurement quote checks the exact object function, not a global fact named quality.
packets.time_policy: One finite job on supported played time; a chance outcome if selected is pinned with its accepted cause.
packets.failure_and_cancellation: Failed work consumes only declared forfeit inputs and retains an honest remaining object/byproduct; wrong custody/tool fit denies use. A returned object and worn-out object differ.
observable_gate: Two serviceable objects with different useful functions produce different actual later quotes/outcomes.
Ordinary serviceable object remains useful.
Salvage demonstrably loses material and conserves ownership.
Transfer/trade/storage/save/reload retains the exact functional object key and provenance.
packets.engine_gap: Existing item quality fields alone do not establish every proposed new tool function. Reconcile current material/fit adapters before adding one.
packets.save_compatibility: No global rarity-tier migration. Optional authored object/function ID only, with existing saved item validators preserved.
packets.proposed_write_scope: New narrow craft application content; root/current material owner integrates exact native consumer.
packets.verification_state: proposal-only; not implemented; source inspiration is selected

packets.title: One volatile ingredient lot with a useful spent form
packets.player_behavior: Gather an original volatile herb lot, choose careful immediate treatment, quick stabilization for travel, or convert older stock to a weaker safe preparation. Unused material becomes an owned spent residue with a useful compost/craft function.
packets.state_owner: New opt-in lot deadline record joined to existing native inventory, custody, job and clock publication. Existing crop warnings remain their owner.
packets.costs: Actual lot, stabilization materials and work time; preservation is a paid method, not a universal freezer buff.
packets.prerequisites: Choose a single new original item family and declare supported-world/body and absence policy before enrollment.
packets.mutations: A lot ID carries quantity, provenance and deadline across bag/chest/escrow/job input. Successful processing declares inherited/reset freshness. Expiry settles once from that exact lot into its safe spent output.
packets.downstream_consumer: Treatment potency or remaining safe handling window and later compost/material use.
packets.time_policy: Supported played time only initially, with explicit freeze under unsupported body/realm and no real-time ageing while closed. Compare current crop-clock joins before integration.
packets.failure_and_cancellation: No fresh refund after paid elapsed spoil time; accepted input ownership and actual deadline survive cancellation according to declared terms. No hostile egg analogue or old-food decay is selected.
observable_gate: A lot expires once with the same deadline after custody/storage movement.
Processing has a documented freshness rule and actual useful consumer.
Unsupported clock/body preserves the selected lot coherently.
Save/reload/import or a failed publication cannot duplicate residue or refresh the lot.
packets.engine_gap: Inventory snapshots currently primarily own counts by item key. General lot merging/splitting and expiry require an explicit versioned adapter, not facts detached from stock.
packets.save_compatibility: New-family enrollment only; older saves/items have no lot decay. Migration and generated-save acceptance required before any persistence change ships.
packets.proposed_write_scope: Isolated lot model/content/host prototype; root owns shared clock/state/native/save joins.
packets.verification_state: proposal-only; not implemented; exact rates/fiction provisional

packets.title: A supplier route with capacity, fuel and an honest interrupted delivery
packets.player_behavior: Commission a willing existing supplier to take a finite kit order between two established places. Choose a normal delivery route, fund a rest/refuel stop, or build a small permanent cargo crossing. The receiver obtains goods only on actual delivery.
packets.state_owner: Existing independent actor/body/stock/custody/work/site/travel owners; actual route planner and receiver support must be named.
packets.costs: Fee, actual supplier-carried goods, their stamina/fuel and route construction stock if selected.
packets.prerequisites: Willing actor, supported independent movement, real custody contract and receiving-site room. One-route prototype only.
packets.mutations: Acceptance transfers/reserves specified cargo and own finite means; travel, unload and return are separate observable states. Shared named interrupt policy can propose rest/refuel when support fails, without altering accepted commitments.
packets.downstream_consumer: Receiver’s real kit use/project; permanent crossing affects future route cost/access rather than granting stock.
packets.time_policy: Existing supported independent clock; no unobserved movement claim beyond admitted adapter. Stop/pause versus reroute is explicit.
packets.failure_and_cancellation: Full receiver waits or takes a selected alternate destination; no path/absent actor/insufficient means preserves actual cargo custody. Interrupted journey and bodily loss are separate, no universal cargo-loss policy.
observable_gate: Order acceptance alone does not increase receiver stock.
Delivered exact cargo decreases supplier stock and increases receiver stock once.
Full/unavailable destination produces visible waiting/reroute without conjured delivery.
Changed return/revisit, save/reload and cancellation preserve route/cargo obligations.
packets.engine_gap: A generic transfer effect is not physical courier movement. Reuse current independent transit bindings or report unsupported segments before accepting work.
packets.save_compatibility: Optional explicit order/route records; old jobs remain frozen and old world absence policies retained.
packets.proposed_write_scope: New one-route content/host only; root owns actor movement/stock/custody integration.
packets.verification_state: proposal-only; not implemented; no source-game rail/grid clone selected

packets.title: A working sample teaches a context-dependent process
packets.player_behavior: Make and demonstrate one working heat-supported process at an established workshop, then record a portable method that can be attempted elsewhere only with compatible material, environment and means. Teaching another willing worker transfers knowledge, not their equipment or fuel.
packets.state_owner: Existing source/power/mastery/knowledge/discovery/native recipe/job owners with one explicit contextual execution rule.
packets.costs: Real sample inputs, an actually supported heated site, own effort or willing instructor time and a consumed test piece.
packets.prerequisites: Actual production/examination receipt, supported sample function and selected local environmental facts. Existing skill XP remains independent.
packets.mutations: Successful sample yields a method discovery and useful output. A later contextual quote checks environment/source/fuel/body/site; teaching stores observed/understood knowledge without copying physical resources.
packets.downstream_consumer: A later cold-region repair or material conversion and an ordinary local alternative.
packets.time_policy: Finite paid work under supported heat/body/site clock. Loss of continuing support suspends or fails according to pinned terms.
packets.failure_and_cancellation: Knowing the recipe with an incompatible environment returns a specific missing condition. Failed demonstration cannot grant mastery or fake a crafted sample.
observable_gate: The actual sample receipt unlocks a useful process.
The same learned method is usable in one supported context and explicitly blocked in another.
Bringing suitable heat/material means makes it usable without resetting the character.
Teaching, transfer, save/reload and failed commitment preserve acquisition versus execution.
packets.engine_gap: Existing predicates can gate selected context, but continuous environment/heat support must be read from a real owner. A global learned flag cannot substitute for that owner.
packets.save_compatibility: Additive opt-in knowledge/method records; absent fields disclose/enroll nothing. No new realm/prestige or blanket engine port.
packets.proposed_write_scope: New narrow original process/sample content; root integrates current heat/site/knowledge consumer.
packets.verification_state: proposal-only; not implemented; original experiment pending director selection
